impact_assessment.why: Each f16 K/V row was converted once per query in a 128-query chunk, repeating the same 128 half-to-float conversions 128 times.
impact_assessment.benefits: Removes redundant conversion work from f16 prefill attention with bit-identical output; expected 3-7% attention.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ids and fidelity must stay identical; dependency: block kernel only; concurrency: per-head scratch in parallel head tasks; state: stack row buffer + heap fallback.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Block differential, fidelity f16/f32, six 2048 pairs and four 4096 pairs, ids parity, full gates.

[1/2] Plan: adopt and price the in-flight 8-query value-accumulation tile in block prefill attention; baseline vs experiment at 2048/4096 on f32 and f16 KV; drop the temporary TGE_GQA_CHUNKS spike unless it earns a retune

impact_assessment.why: A prior session left an unrecorded value-tile edit and a TGE_GQA_CHUNKS env spike in the working tree; G-001/G-002 require a baseline, a measured verdict and a log entry before continuing.
impact_assessment.benefits: The tile keeps 8 x head_dim accumulators in L1 (2-4 KiB) instead of the 128-token block working set (~32-64 KiB); if pass-2 output traffic is the bottleneck it is a free, bit-identical prefill gain.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ids and fidelity must stay bit-identical; dependency: block attention kernel only; concurrency: per-head stack scratch 8 x head_dim; state: tile re-streams each value row once per 8-query tile, so large blocks may lose bandwidth.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Same-source baseline and experiment binaries, interleaved same-binary pairs at 2048/4096 on f32 and f16, ids parity, block differential test, full 146-case suite, revert on no consistent win.

[1/2] Plan: retest 128-row prefill chunks vs the shipped 64-row cap above 4096 after the value tile; 8161-token f16 pairs, total prefill and phase ratios, ids parity; revert if 64 still wins

impact_assessment.why: The 8192-token chunk rule was decided before the value tile, when 128-row chunks lost 7-11% to attention working-set cost; the tile removed half that working set, and 128 halves the weight passes.
impact_assessment.benefits: If 128 now wins at 8k, long-prompt prefill gets the 1.18-1.49x chunk benefit that already applies at 2048/4096, with bit-identical ids.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ids and fidelity must stay bit-identical; dependency: buffers are already sized for 128 rows; concurrency: prefill pool; state: one chunk-selection branch.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Same-source 64 vs 128 binaries, alternating pairs at 8161 tokens on f16, attention/matvec phase split, ids parity, 146 tests, fidelity, revert on no consistent win.

impact_assessment.why: The implicit state-machine audit found silent precedence leaks, missing end-of-generation ids, unguarded ISA calls, and failures that abort after a full model load; these hurt UX, DX and AX without any measured benefit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deterministic flag semantics, fail-before-load errors, machine-readable info, and honest resolved state; no arithmetic or performance defaults change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: exit codes/output lines; dependency: stdlib/git only; concurrency: none in the changed paths; state: CLI parsers, config read, GGUF bounds, docs.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure helpers with failing-first unit tests, append-only output, full 146+ suite, fidelity unchanged, aikit check 4/4, local commits then authorized push.

[1/2] Plan: implement the two deferred state items that are additive and testable: sequence-aware forward + per-slot reset, and placement that costs all requested KV slots at load

impact_assessment.why: The audit's D1/D2a gaps are real API/admission lies: the model reports sequence_count but forward addresses slot 0, and load validates one slot while allocating sequences.
impact_assessment.benefits: A truthful multi-sequence API and a load decision that cannot be admitted over the KV budget it allocates.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive overloads; placement may clamp context for multi-session loads (correctly); dependency: none; concurrency: single per-instance assumption unchanged; state: KV slot indexing and reset range.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Synthetic phi model with sequences=2, slot-offset unit test, plan session test, full suite, fidelity unchanged, roadmap update, local commit then push.
